standard_prerequisites.name: Membership strictly lowers rank
standard_prerequisites.use: Line 685: c in B forces rank(c) in rank(B).

core_obligations: Minimal-rank witness (proof line 684): fix nonempty A and choose B in A of least possible rank.
Descent step (lines 684-686): any c in B has rank(c) in rank(B) by the member-rank lemma, so c cannot lie in A by minimality of B; hence B is an epsilon-minimal element of A, i.e. Foundation holds.
proof_roadmap: Pick a member of A with least rank.
Show every element of it leaves A by rank descent.
